result:
If I could change one thing, it would be to make empathy the default reflex instead of the exception.

Not just kindness when it's convenient, but a real, automatic pause where people actually try to understand what someone else is feeling before they react to them. 

If that were the baseline, most of the rest would follow. Politics, business, relationships, conflict, art... all of it gets better when people stop needing to be convinced to care first.
